title: Bringing Salesforce into Claude
summary: "Salesforce in Claude" beta plugin brings live CRM data integration with 37 skills for account research, call prep, deal management, and automated documentation. It consolidates Salesforce, email, and Slack data while preserving permission boundaries and already powers 7,000 sellers at early adopters like GitLab and Siemens.

title: Claude for Small Business launches new workflows, integrations, and training programs
summary: Claude for Small Business expanded to 43 workflows and added integrations with Shopify, Salesforce, HubSpot, Xero, Gusto, Square, and Stripe, responding to feedback from 1,000+ business owners. The rollout includes free workshops in 10 US cities and webinars from 14 tech partners, with 150 trained community trainers now running 750+ workshops.

title: Projects redesigned: from folder to conversation
summary: Claude Projects redesigned from folders to conversation-based coordination with threaded execution, a coordinator for delegation, shared memory, and file library. Users describe desired outcomes and Claude autonomously delegates tasks, coordinates parallel work, and assembles results, eliminating manual handoffs. Currently in beta for Claude Pro and Max subscribers.

title: Working at the frontier: How Balyasny Asset Management evaluates and governs Claude Fable 5
summary: Balyasny Asset Management, a $38B asset manager, deployed Claude Fable 5 internally achieving 89.4% accuracy on financial tasks versus 86.1% for prior models. The company built BAMAgent to run thousands of autonomous agents 24/7 securely, framing safety around data access controls, tool permissions, and human oversight rather than model capability alone.

title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
summary: Anthropic merged Claude Cowork and chat into a unified platform where context, skills, and connectors flow across all interfaces. Introduces Claude Docs, Slides, and Design within conversations, with auto-detection of appropriate outputs (edit, present, download). Rollout begins with Pro and Max plans.

title: Building an AI-native revenue organization
summary: New eBook for revenue leaders on deploying Claude across sales teams with a three-phase rollout plan (setup, pilot, scale), role-based use cases, and ROI measurement framework. Cox Communications case study shows 7x first-year return and 86% reduction in lead validation costs, demonstrating value of cohesive company-wide AI implementation.
